  • Constructor Details

    • Branch

      private Branch(RealGasPipeDecompression segment, String branchId, TwoSidedRealGasPipeRupture.AxialDirection axialDirection, double totalPipeLengthM, double ruptureDistanceFromLeftM, double branchLengthM)
      Creates a process adapter around one conservative branch solver.
      Parameters:
      segment - branch finite-volume solver
      branchId - stable branch label
      axialDirection - outward jet direction
      totalPipeLengthM - total pre-rupture pipe length in m
      ruptureDistanceFromLeftM - rupture position from the left end in m
      branchLengthM - branch inventory length in m
